claims.disproof_condition: 條件：鑽針廠（尖點、鼎泰、高僑、Union Tool）的一手寫出大尺寸鑽針棒缺料、配額或交期拉長（往緊的方向），或中鎢高新寫出鑽針棒產能過剩、降價（往鬆的方向）。核查頻率：每季（各家定期報告）。觸發後 48 小時：重讀鑽針層讀圖的上游段（鑽針棒會不會卡）。
claims.statement: Upstream input (China Tungsten High-tech announcement 2026-77): its wholly owned Zhuzhou Cemented Carbide will add 20 million PCB drill rods per year for larger drills (diameter > 1.15 mm), saying AI servers sharply raise PCB drill consumption, downstream makers keep expanding, and its existing rod capacity cannot meet demand; the company calls itself the leader of the full PCB-tool chain (rods and drills). Self-reported; buyers' annual reports read earlier (Topoint, Dtech) described carbide rod supply as adequate with three or more qualified suppliers.
